terra.problem: Jesus says to take no money in their belts. The passage does not say the belts are empty.
The passage does not say there will be no speech or scene when they leave.
Saying that walking away is all the instruction says leaves out Jesus' explanation that shaking off the dust is a testimony against them.
The statement that tearing clothes appears elsewhere in the Bible needs a reference.
Jesus says not to take a second tunic. The passage does not say the Twelve each own only one.
The explanation assumes the baker wanted a gentler word, which Papa Dorin has not been told.
Preaching was just the start presents an order of events that the passage does not establish.
The packing instructions do not establish whether the Twelve could collect offerings. The passage simply does not mention them doing so.
The statement that ashes appear elsewhere in the Bible needs a reference.
